edits.old: No screen in this story. The ACE front-end shell shows the MSG-P4-004 banner while a grant is active, and the suite reads the same end time through GET /api/recovery/access/v1/me/session. The access log is read through the P4 contract until SCR-43 Roles and access, and access to a case is read through the decision log query SCR-38 (RWB-E2-005). Neither screen is built or tested here.
